news.author: Nate Miller
news.title: Greg Newsome II (rib) practices in full
news.desc: Greg Newsome II (rib) was a full participant at Saturday's practice session.
news.impact: Newsome has been limited by a rib injury at practice earlier this week, but he was a full go Saturday and carries no injury designation for Monday's matchup with the Rams.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) out against Saints
news.desc: Zay Flowers (hamstring) has been downgraded to out against the New Orleans Saints.
news.impact: With Flowers out, Mark Andrews will become the primary target for Lamar Jackson. Rashod Bateman will be the Ravens top receiver on the depth chart, but it would be extremely hard to start him, given the amount of routes he run for just one target last week. Rookie Elijah Sarratt could be an interesting watch if called up, but it's best to start Andrews and move on.

news.author: Nate Miller
news.title: Eddy Pineiro (illness) ready to go for Sunday's game
news.desc: Eddy Pineiro (illness) will kick for the 49ers in Week 2's matchup with the Dolphins.
news.impact: Pineiro has missed practice all week due to being under the weather, but the veteran kicker will be ready to go Sunday. Pineiro hit 2-of-3 field goals and all three of his PATs in Week 1.

news.author: Nate Miller
news.title: Lewis Bond elevated for Week 2
news.desc: Lewis Bond has been elevated to the Texans' roster for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
news.impact: A sixth-round pick for the Texans in this year's draft, Bond is set to make his NFL debut when he steps on the field Sunday. The Texans are lacking some depth at wide receiver right now, with go-to guy Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled out.

news.author: Nate Miller
news.title: Javon Hargrave (knee, concussion) will not play Sunday
news.desc: Javon Hargrave (knee, concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday.
news.impact: Hargrave will not be available for Sunday's matchup with the Jets, as he is dealing with multiple issues. Jonathan Ford and Chris McClellan will likely see more snaps on defense.

news.author: Nate Miller
news.title: Lukas Van Ness (concussion) likely to go in Week 2
news.desc: Lukas Van Ness (concussion) is expected to be on the field Sunday.
news.impact: Van Ness has cleared the concussion protocol and should be in action against the Jets in Week 2. The fourth-year pro recorded four tackles and a sack against the Vikings in Week 1.

news.author: Nate Miller
news.title: Carlton Davis III (neck) won't play Sunday
news.desc: Carlton Davis III (neck) will not be available for Week 2's matchup against the Steelers.
news.impact: Davis did not practice this week due to a neck issue. The veteran corner will take a seat on Sunday, as Charles Woods will likely step into more snaps on defense. Davis will try to be back for Week 3.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Puka Nacua (hip) questionable for Monday night
news.desc: Puka Nacua (hip) did not practice on Saturday and is now labeled questionable for Monday night against the Giants.
news.impact: Nacua has now missed two practices in a row with a hip issue, and that does not bode well for his status on game day. Fantasy managers will need to have contingency plans ready in case he sits. Davante Adams is next up for targets, but Colby Parkinson and Terrance Ferguson could see more looks. Konata Mumpfield is likely next up behind Puka with Jordan Whittington also questionable.

news.author: Chris Schommer
news.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) ruled out Sunday
news.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) has been ruled out for Week 2 for the Pittsburgh Steelers according to Mike Garafolo.
news.impact: Pittman Jr. will be sidelined after struggling to reach the practice field for head coach Mike McCarthy, with Roman Wilson and Germie Bernard in line for increased roles behind No. 1 wideout DK Metcalf against the Patriots Sunday.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) placed on injured reserve
news.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) has been placed on injured reserve and will be sidelined for at least four weeks.
news.impact: The Jets are placing their first-round rookie on injured reserve after he suffered an ankle injury in his NFL debut last week. He is going to miss at least four weeks as a result, but he's not expected to be out much beyond that. Adonai Mitchell and Kenyon Sadiq will both see increased opportunities in his absence for the next few weeks at least.
